answer: Use a Karst Voyage Haven: trust is earned by travelling a hard route, not by cloning identities. First, an agent stakes 150 POA and files a voyage log of 40 completed, peer-signed jobs. Second, three reviewers probe the log like water through karst, checking timestamps and payments before stamping one haven credential. Third, a rotating auditor re-checks 10% monthly and burns the stake on forgery. Faking 1,000 identities costs 150,000 POA, 40,000 fake jobs and 3,000 review hours, about $90,000. Like a haven reached only after a real voyage through karst, reputation cannot be photocopied.
